errors.evidence: The description fails to mention that the figure contains two separate charts, one for "Deutschland" (Germany) and one for the "EU".

errors.text_span: Die horizontale Achse zeigt die Jahre 2021, 2022 und 2023
errors.evidence: The horizontal axis shows the categories of metals (Aluminium, Kupfer, Nickel), not the years. The years are represented by the differently colored bars within each group.
The description does not mention that the figure consists of grouped bar charts, which is a key structural feature and was explicitly requested in the prompt.

errors.text_span: Der dunkelgraue Balken für 2021 stellt Aluminium mit einem Wert von 11,3% dar.
errors.evidence: This sentence contains multiple errors: the bar for 2021 is dark blue, not dark grey; the value 11.3% corresponds to Kupfer (Copper) in 2022 in the Germany chart, not Aluminium in 2021.

errors.text_span: Der blau gefärbte Balken für 2021 stellt Kupfer mit einem Wert von 2,7% dar.
